news.title: Gold Stopped Protecting Portfolios When Stocks Needed It Most
news.summary: SPDR Gold Shares ETF is a hold as central bank buying and liquidity-driven selling support retain gold despite its sharp decline.

news.summary_zh: SPDR Gold Shares ETF 維持持有評級，因央行買盤與流動性驅動的賣壓支撐，儘管黃金急跌仍能維持。

news.title: Bessent Warns the Fed Could Be Making a “Policy Mistake” if It Over-Tightens
news.summary: Three Treasury warnings in ten days, and the Fed still hasn't blinked. While stocks swing wildly, long bonds barely budge, and that gap reveals what investors truly expect before the December 9 decision.
news.title_zh: Bessent 警告若過度緊縮，聯準會可能正在犯下「政策錯誤」
news.summary_zh: 十天內三次財政部警告，聯準會仍未眨眼。股票劇烈波動，長債幾乎不動，這個缺口揭示了投資者在 December 9 決定前的真實預期。

news.title: The New York Fed’s John Williams Won’t Rule Out Back-to-Back Rate Hikes
news.summary: Williams gave a calm speech, then said something sharper to reporters. One condition could push the Fed toward another hike right after December, and it decides which Treasury ETFs bruise and which ones recover.
news.title_zh: 紐約聯準會 John Williams 不排除連續加息

news.title: Huang's Return Lifts Stocks, But The Bond Market Echoes The Fed's 2018 Policy Mistake
news.summary: Key markets are pricing in a slowing economy, falling inflation. Yet, the Fed is talking about hiking more aggressively.
news.title_zh: 黃仁勳回歸提振股市，但債券市場呼應聯準會的 2018 政策錯誤
news.summary_zh: 關鍵市場正在為經濟放緩、通膨下降定價。然而，聯準會卻在談論更激進地升息。

news.title: Treasury Yields Snapshot: November 20, 2026
news.summary: The yield on the 10-year note finished November 20, 2026 at 4.92% while the 2-year note ended at 4.63%.
news.title_zh: 公債殖利率快照：November 20, 2026
news.summary_zh: 10 年期債券收益率收於 November 20, 2026，報 4.92%；而 2 年期債券收益率收於 4.63%。

news.title: The Fed’s Biggest Dove Sees No Clear Path Back to 2% Inflation
news.summary: When even a policymaker known for patience starts sounding alarmed, bond buyers lose a key ally. Goolsbee's warning raises a harder question for anyone holding long Treasuries: what happens if the Fed's last dove stops defending them?
news.title_zh: 聯準會最大鴿派人物看不出回歸 2% 通膨的明確路徑
news.summary_zh: 當連以耐心著稱的決策者開始發出警訊時，債券買家就失去了一位關鍵盟友。古爾斯比的警告對持有長期公債的任何人提出了更棘手的問題：如果聯準會最後一位鴿派人物停止為它們護航，會發生什麼？

news.title: Bond ETFs Haven’t Been This Rewarding in Years, So Why Is Wall Street Dumping Them?
news.summary: Investors are fleeing bond funds just as new bonds pay the most in years. One yield level will decide whether the exodus was smart or a costly mistake for anyone holding the safe 40% of a portfolio.
news.title_zh: 債券 ETF 多年來最具吸引力，為何華爾街卻在拋售？
news.summary_zh: 投資人正逃離債券基金，就在此時新債券殖利率創多年新高。某一殖利率水準將決定這波出逃對持有投資組合安全 40% 的人來說，是明智之舉還是昂貴錯誤。

news.title: A Monthly Check at 3 Levels of Risk: VTEB, TLT and EMB, Ranked
news.summary: A retiree's monthly bond fund check can stay steady while the share price behind it quietly collapses. Ranking three popular payers on both risks produces two lists that point in opposite directions, and one fund flips from safe to scary.
news.title_zh: 在 3 風險層級的每月檢視：VTEB、TLT 與 EMB 排名
news.summary_zh: 退休族的每月債券基金檢視可能看似穩定，但背後的股價卻悄悄崩塌。根據兩種風險對三檔熱門配息基金排名，產生兩份方向相反的名單，且有一檔基金從安全變得驚悚。

news.title: Some Fed Officials Wanted to Hike in October. A Half-Point Hike Is on the Table.
news.summary: Fed minutes revealed a hawkish bloc bigger than the October vote let on, and Governor Waller says the central bank may need to shock people. Long bond holders now face a fork where one path rescues them and the other keeps squeezing.
news.title_zh: 部分聯準會官員想在十月升息。半碼升息在考慮範圍內。
news.summary_zh: 聯準會會議記錄揭示鷹派陣營比十月投票顯示的更大，Waller 總裁表示央行可能需要震懾市場。長債持有者現在面臨岔路，一條路能救他們，另一條則持續擠壓。

news.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
news.summary: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
news.title_zh: 再維持 5% 以上兩天，公債殖利率將追平 2007 的紀錄
news.summary_zh: 10 年期殖利率已連續四個交易日站上鮮少觸及的關鍵線，且債券拍賣與聯準會會議紀錄將在數小時內公布。這波連續漲勢能否延續，將決定長債持有者的後續走向。

news.title: Traders Now See a 95% Chance the Fed Hikes Rates in December

news.title: Following Jensen Huang Exit, Investors Fear Nvidia’s AI Lead Will Collapse
news.summary: Even though Nvidia remains a massive holding and is forecasting up to 70% growth in its next fiscal year, the stock has been trading at a steep discount around 12 to 13 times forward earnings amid major leadership and competitive shifts. Following Jensen Huang’s departure, investors are wrestling with how deeply Nvidia's advantage was tied to his hands-on leadership, annual product cadence and supply chain relationships like its handshake deals with Taiwan Semiconductor. 24/7 Wall St. Analysts Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith examine what Nvidia might look like with Jensen Huang gone and why fears of a collapse are valid.
news.title_zh: 隨著黃仁勳離職，投資者擔心 Nvidia 的 AI 領先地位將崩塌
news.summary_zh: 儘管 Nvidia 仍是巨大持倉，並預測下一財年增長高達 70%，但該股票在重大領導層和競爭格局變化中，以約 12 to 13 times 遠期盈利的陡峭折價交易。隨著黃仁勳離職，投資者正在權衡 Nvidia 的優勢究竟有多深地依賴其親力親為的領導風格、年度產品節奏，以及像與台積電的握手協議等供應鏈關係。24/7 華爾街分析師 Eric Bleeker 和 Austin Smith 分析了沒有黃仁勳的 Nvidia 可能樣貌，以及崩塌恐懼為何合理。

news.title: Chinese AI Firms Confront Dire Future as U.S. Tightens Access to Chips and Tokens
news.summary: China’s AI model developers are suddenly confronting a dire future, as both the U.S. government and American AI rivals aggressively clamp down on tactics the Chinese companies have long relied on to develop their models. The U.S. Commerce Department this month introduced a rule aimed at throttling Chinese companies’ access to advanced Nvidia chips in data centers outside China. The new rule, which plugs a yearslong loophole in Washington’s chip export controls on China, was released after the ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who has favored greater Chinese access to Nvidia’s chips. It remains in effect for now despite Huang’s reinstatement Monday.

news.summary: Micron Technology makes the memory chips inside PCs, phones and servers. Its gross margin is the share of sales left after the direct cost of making its chips. news.title: If Micron is Between $585-$600 Days Before Dec. 17 Earnings, Buy It
news.summary: Micron has beaten estimates nine quarters straight, yet its stock keeps sinking after earnings. With a chip sell-off still raging and AI memory sold out, one price zone could decide whether the next report rewards patient buyers.

news.title: The Consensus on Micron Stock Is Changing. Here’s What Investors Should Know
news.summary: Micron has dropped 23% in a month while its revenue nearly quintupled, and Wall Street's targets sit far above where our model lands. Why did our rating flip, and what could break the memory boom?

news.summary: Micron stock has multibagger potential given the strong earnings growth it can deliver over the coming year.

news.summary_zh: 鑑於未來一年可帶來的強勁盈利增長，Micron 股票具備多倍股潛力。

news.title: Is Micron's Record Margin Squeezing Apple And HP?
news.summary: Micron Technology makes the memory chips inside PCs, phones and servers. Its gross margin is the share of sales left after the direct cost of making its chips. That margin hit 86.8% in the three months to Sep 3, 2026. It was 44.7% a year earlier, so it rose 42.1 points. It is the highest in our quarterly data back to March 2015.
news.title_zh: 美光創紀錄毛利率是否擠壓蘋果與 HP？
news.summary_zh: 美光科技製造用於個人電腦、手機和伺服器的記憶體晶片。其毛利率為扣除製造晶片直接成本後剩餘的銷售額比重。該毛利率在截至 Sep 3, 2026 的三個月內達到 86.8%。一年前為 44.7%，因此上升了 42.1 個百分點。這是我們季度數據追溯至 March 2015 以來的最高值。

news.title: US Semiconductor Stocks Extend Losses as AI Investment Concerns, Tariff Risks and Rate Expectations Weigh on Markets
news.summary: US semiconductor and technology hardware stocks came under renewed selling pressure in premarket trading on Wednesday as investors reassessed the potential returns from artificial intelligence infrastructure investments amid rising borrowing costs and renewed trade uncertainty. Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) declined 5.
news.title_zh: 美國半導體股延續跌勢，AI 投資憂慮、關稅風險與利率預期壓制市場
news.summary_zh: 美國半導體與科技硬體股在週三盤前交易再度面臨拋售壓力，投資人在借貸成本上升與貿易不確定性重燃下，重新評估人工智慧基礎建設投資的潛在回報。Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) 下跌 5。

news.title: 3 AI Investment Stocks We’re Buying Today And Why We’re Selling On Micron
news.summary: With AI infrastructure stocks pulling back 30% to 80% from their highs, many investors are making adjustments to their portfolio. Eric Bleeker, the co-host of The AI Investor Podcast, recently shared three AI-related stocks he's buying as we head into 2027, as well as why he is selling on Micron. Among his recommendations is Analog Devices, a longtime industry winner with a comprehensive portfolio in sensing, precision motion, and power management that stands to capture thousands of dollars in hardware content per humanoid robot.

news.summary_zh: 兩檔晶片股在一年內都上漲超過一倍，且都位於 AI 支出的核心，然而一檔的遠期市盈率接近 4x，另一檔則在 30x 左右交易。這個差距可能決定誰能回報耐心的投資人。

news.title: Semiconductor Stocks like Micron, Marvell, and Bloom Energy See Massive Gains as Jensen Huang Returns to NVIDIA
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., covers the news that Jensen Huang is returning to NVIDIA, announced shortly before Monday's open. Shares of NVIDIA are up 31%. The Nasdaq (Nasdaq: QQQ) is up about 5.7%, the S&P 500 about 4% and the Dow Jones 2.1%. The VanEck semiconductor ETF (Nasdaq: SMH) is up 13%. Bleeker names three stocks with the most to gain outside NVIDIA. Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) fell hard after big gains at the start of 2026, and Huang himself has said it could be the next trillion dollar company. It's rising along with the broader optics group after its recent move for Lumentum. Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) is up 14%, recovering Friday's losses, and Huang's return supports confidence in ecosystems like NeoClouds. Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) is up 19% in a broad rebound of behind-the-meter power stocks that the elections had beaten down. Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) and many hyperscalers, which could have gained from losing a key rival, are seeing much more muted moves. Many of these stocks are up 15% or 20% but are mostly replacing losses from Friday and sometimes Thursday. Rising rates and the midterm elections remain as overhangs, and many chip stocks sit more than 50% below recent highs. Bleeker's question is whether this becomes an enduring rally.
news.title_zh: 隨著 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA，Micron、Marvell 和 Bloom Energy 等半導體股大漲
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 報導 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA 的消息，該消息在週一開盤前不久公布。NVIDIA 股價上漲 31%。納斯達克 (Nasdaq: QQQ) 上漲約 5.7%，標普 500 上漲約 4%，道瓊 2.1%。VanEck 半導體 ETF (Nasdaq: SMH) 上漲 13%。Bleeker 點出 NVIDIA 之外最有獲利潛力的三檔股票。Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) 在 2026 初大漲後重挫，Huang 本人曾說它可能成為下一家兆元公司。隨著其近期收購 Lumentum，該股隨光學族群上漲。Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) 上漲 14%，收復週五跌幅，Huang 重返支持對 NeoClouds 等生態系統的信心。Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) 上漲 19%，在用戶側電力股廣泛反彈中，這些股票此前因選舉而被打壓。Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) 和許多超大規模廠商，本可能從失去關鍵對手中獲利，卻只見溫和漲幅。許多這類股票上漲 15% 或 20%，但主要只是填補週五有時還有週四的跌幅。利率上升和期中選舉仍是壓頂因素，許多晶片股仍在近期高點下方逾 50%。Bleeker 的問題在於這是否會成為持久反彈。

news.title: Palantir Rips 10% to Lead Software Stocks. Cloudflare and ServiceNow Also Join ‘Jensen Rally’
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA is lifting technology stocks on Monday. The NASDAQ was up more than 7% as of 1:30 p.m. Eastern, after opening with a 3% pre-market gain following Friday's sell-off. Chip stocks as a group rose more than 13%. Software is also higher, but the gains are uneven. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) are each up about 3%, while the IGV software ETF is up 4%. The biggest winners are companies that benefit from sovereign AI and a strong open-weight ecosystem. Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) leads at 10%, and Palantir has been one of the loudest backers of sovereign AI. Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) is up roughly 7%, and ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is up 5%, helped by its control tower software that guides customers between models and agentic workloads. Anthropic is lagging, since Huang has pushed open-weight models that pressure leading labs like Anthropic and OpenAI. Bleeker's takeaway: if Huang keeps backing open weight model makers, Palantir, Cloudflare and ServiceNow, up 5% to 10%, should keep outperforming the 2% to 3% gains in the rest of software.
news.title_zh: Palantir 飆升 10% 領漲軟體股。Cloudflare 和 ServiceNow 也加入「Jensen Rally」
news.summary_zh: 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 在 24/7 華爾街表示，黃仁勳重返 NVIDIA 於週一帶動科技股上漲。納斯達克指數截至 1:30 下午 (東部時間) 上漲逾 7%，此前受週五拋售潮影響，盤前漲幅達 3%。晶片股群體上漲逾 13%。軟體股也上漲，但漲幅不均。微軟 (NASDAQ: MSFT) 和 Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) 各上漲約 3%，而 IGV 軟體 ETF 上漲 4%。最大贏家是受惠於主權 AI 和強大開放權重生態系的公司。Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) 領漲 10%，且 Palantir 一直是主權 AI 最響亮的支持者之一。Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) 上漲約 7%，ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) 上漲 5%，得益於其控制塔軟體引導客戶在模型和代理式工作負載之間切換。Anthropic 表現落後，因黃仁勳推動開放權重模型，對 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等領先實驗室構成壓力。Bleeker 的結論：若黃仁勳持續支持開放權重模型製造商，Palantir、Cloudflare 和 ServiceNow 上漲 5% to 10%，應會持續優於軟體其餘部分 2% to 3% 的漲幅。

news.title: IREN Sinks 15%, CoreWeave Tumbles 14% as Neocloud Stocks Backtrack Monday’s Rally; Nebius Drops 13%
news.summary: Monday's AI cloud bounce vanished within hours, yet the stock with the least debt is falling the hardest. What is hammering IREN more than its more leveraged rivals, and can a $20 billion backlog calm the market?
news.title_zh: IREN 下跌 15%，CoreWeave 重挫 14%，Neocloud 股票回吐週一漲幅；Nebius 下跌 13%
news.summary_zh: 週一的 AI 雲端反彈在數小時內消失，債務最少的股票反而跌最重。什麼因素讓 IREN 比槓桿更高的競爭對手承受更大打擊？$20 billion 積壓訂單能安撫市場嗎？

news.title: IREN Fell 42% This Month Even After The Market Jump on NVIDIA News: This Wall Street Pro Maintains That 440% Returns Are Coming After Q3 Earnings Downgrades
news.summary: A delayed billion-dollar milestone, a funding gap and a bruising month have analysts slashing targets yet still cheering. One date on the calendar will show whether IREN's demand story outruns its financing problem.
news.title_zh: IREN 本月下跌 42%，即使市場因 NVIDIA 消息跳漲：這位華爾街專業人士堅持 440% 回報將在 Q3 盈利下調後到來
news.summary_zh: 延遲的十億美元里程碑、資金缺口和慘烈的一個月，導致分析師大幅下調目標價卻仍看好。行事曆上的某個日期將顯示 IREN 的需求故事能否超越其融資問題。

news.summary: NBIS had separately disclosed that Databricks chose its cloud for AI research.

news.summary_zh: NBIS 另行披露 Databricks 選擇其雲端進行 AI 研究。

news.title: IREN Sinks 11% in a Week Despite Jensen Huang’s Return. Its $6 Billion Funding Gap Meets “More Selective” Capital Markets
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN stock fell 11% over the past week in the AI selloff, despite a 24% jump Monday when Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. Huang’s return eases the risk that Nvidia, IREN’s $3.
news.title_zh: IREN 下跌 11% 在一週內，儘管 Jensen Huang 回歸。其 $6 Billion 資金缺口遇上「更挑剔」的資本市場
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 IREN 股價在過去一週於 AI 拋售潮中下跌 11%，儘管週一因 Nvidia 重新任命 Jensen Huang 為 CEO 而上漲 24%。Huang 的回歸緩解了 Nvidia、IREN 的 $3 風險。

news.title: Nebius & CoreWeave Jump 21% While Oracle Sees 12% Gains on Monday Following Jensen’s Return
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says neocloud stocks rallied Monday on the return of Jensen Huang to NVIDIA. At 1:30 p.m. Eastern, Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) and CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) were each up 21%, IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) was up 25%, TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) was up 13% and Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) was up 12%. Leading ETFs showed software up closer to 4% and semiconductors up 13%. Bleeker also pointed to two company-specific items. The New York Times reported that Anthropic's demand is so large that SpaceX needs new data centers by October to fill its orders. On Friday, Oracle said it has secured all funding needed for its OpenAI contract. Bleeker notes Nvidia helped build neoclouds with funding, technical expertise and chips. He calls it a one-day win. Nebius is down 38% over the past month, CoreWeave 12% and Oracle 10%. Over six months Nebius is down more than 50%, Oracle 40% and CoreWeave 55%. Bleeker names three drivers of the selloff: higher rates and wider credit default swaps, political worries after the midterms, and Huang's removal. Only the last has reversed. Going forward, watch the Fed's rate path and how politics affects project locations such as Texas.
news.title_zh: Nebius 與 CoreWeave 上漲 21%，而 Oracle 在 Jensen 回歸後於週一錄得 12% 漲幅
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資官 Eric Bleeker 表示，隨著 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA，新雲端股票週一反彈。美國東部時間 1:30 下午，Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) 和 CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) 各上漲 21%，IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) 上漲 25%，TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) 上漲 13%，Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) 上漲 12%。領先 ETF 顯示軟體上漲接近 4%，半導體上漲 13%。Bleeker 還指出了兩項公司特定事項。《紐約時報》報導，Anthropic 的需求龐大到 SpaceX 需要在十月前建立新數據中心以滿足訂單。週五，Oracle 表示已獲得其 OpenAI 合約所需的所有資金。Bleeker 指出 Nvidia 以資金、技術專長和晶片協助建立新雲端服務商。他稱這只是一日勝果。過去一個月 Nebius 下跌 38%，CoreWeave 12%，Oracle 10%。六個月來 Nebius 下跌超過 50%，Oracle 40%，CoreWeave 55%。Bleeker 指出拋售的三大驅動因素：利率上升和信用違約互換擴大、中期選舉後的政治擔憂，以及 Huang 的離職。只有最後一項已扭轉。展望未來，關注美聯儲利率路徑以及政治如何影響德州等項目地點。

news.title: Dell Wants Up to 45% More on Signed AI Deals. IREN Has a Big Problem
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDell, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are asking for up to 45% more for AI servers already under contract, the Financial Times reported. IREN agreed to buy about $5.
news.title_zh: Dell 要求在已簽署 AI 交易上再漲價高達 45%。IREN 面臨大問題
news.summary_zh: 《金融時報》報導，Dell、HPE、Lenovo 和 Supermicro 要求為已簽約的 AI 伺服器再漲價高達 45%。IREN 同意購買約 $5。

news.title: Scott Galloway Says Neoclouds Are “Going to Default.” CoreWeave’s Interest Bill Is the Problem
news.summary: Key TakeawaysScott Galloway predicts neocloud defaults and bankruptcies, naming CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN after a brutal week for all three. CoreWeave’s third-quarter interest expense of $846 million was about 4x its operating income, and it’s still rising.
news.title_zh: Scott Galloway 稱新雲端服務商「將違約」。CoreWeave 的利息支出是問題所在
news.summary_zh: Scott Galloway 在三家公司經歷慘烈一週後預測新雲端服務商將違約和破產，點名 CoreWeave、Nebius 和 IREN。CoreWeave 第三季利息支出達 $846 million，約為其營業收入的 4x，且仍在上升。

news.title: Bad News for CoreWeave and IREN: GPU Lenders Now Want “50 to 60 Percent” Loan-to-Value, Down From 80%
news.summary: Key TakeawaysGPU lenders now want 50% to 60% loan-to-value, down from 80% over the summer, according to Odd Lots guest Stanley Lee. At those levels, a neocloud has to cover 40% to 50% of each chip itself, up from 20%.
news.title_zh: CoreWeave 和 IREN 的壞消息：GPU 放款方現在要求「50 to 60 Percent」貸款價值比，低於 80%
news.summary_zh: 據 Odd Lots 嘉賓 Stanley Lee 指出，GPU 放款方現在要求 50% to 60% 貸款價值比，低於夏季的 80%。在這些水平下，新雲端服務商必須自行承擔每顆晶片的 40% to 50%，高於之前的 20%。

news.title: IREN Soars 25%, Nebius Up 22% as Neoclouds Rebound After Brutal Week
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN rose 25% today as AI stocks bounced back from the Nasdaq’s worst week since 2020. IREN had no news and led last week’s neocloud selloff with a 36% drop.
news.title_zh: IREN 飆漲 25%，Nebius 上漲 22%，新雲端服務商在慘烈一週後反彈
news.summary_zh: IREN 今日上漲 25%，AI 股票從自 2020 以來 Nasdaq 最慘烈的一週中反彈。IREN 沒有消息面支撐，卻以 36% 跌幅領跌上週新雲端服務商拋售潮。

news.title: Nebius Rallies 30% Despite New U.S. Curbs Threatening Neocloud Business in Southeast Asia; IREN Jumps 24%, CoreWeave Climbs 7%
news.summary: Investors are bidding up AI cloud stocks while Washington targets the rental loophole Chinese firms use to reach Nvidia chips. Only one of three neocloud players has a direct foothold in the affected region, and a February deadline looms.
news.title_zh: Nebius 反彈 30% 儘管新的美國限制威脅東南亞 Neocloud 業務；IREN 飆升 24%，CoreWeave 上漲 7%
news.summary_zh: 投資人正在推高 AI 雲端股票，而華盛頓鎖定中國企業用來獲取 Nvidia 晶片的租賃漏洞。三家 neocloud 參與者中僅有一家在受影響地區擁有直接立足點，且二月截止日期迫在眉睫。

news.title: Gavin Baker Says “Consolidation Is Probably Coming” for Neoclouds That Can’t Get Prepayments. Here’s Who Can
news.summary: Key TakeawaysGavin Baker says consolidation is probably coming for neoclouds that can’t win customer prepayments and rely entirely on private credit. CoreWeave and IREN are clearly winning prepayments, Nebius likely is too, and Microsoft is prepaying 20% of IREN’s contract.
news.title_zh: Gavin Baker 說「整合很可能到來」針對無法獲得預付款的 Neoclouds。這裡是誰能做到
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Gavin Baker 指出，無法贏得客戶預付款且完全依賴私人信貸的 neoclouds 很可能面臨整合。CoreWeave 和 IREN 明顯贏得預付款，Nebius 也很可能，而 Microsoft 正預付 IREN 合約的 20%。

news.title: CRWV, IREN, NBIS Rally After Sell-Off — New US Curbs Threaten Southeast Asia Neocloud Business
news.summary: The trio lost over a quarter of their value last week.
news.title_zh: CRWV、IREN、NBIS 於拋售後反彈 — 新的美國限制威脅東南亞 Neocloud 業務
news.summary_zh: 這三檔股票上週損失超過四分之一的價值。
